The '''44th Division''', also known as '''Rostu's Renegades''', was a [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and military personnel from other [[Species/Legends|species]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] under the command of [[Brevet]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nick Rostu]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Having assumed control of the unit in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Rostu and the division participated in many battles during the final two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war, including the [[Battle of Ando]], the [[Battle of Atraken]], and the [[Battle of Bassadro]].<ref name="CN" />

Despite Nick Rostu remembering [[Gender/Legends|his]] division's service as chaotic and driven by luck, the Republic's [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] portrayed the 44th Division as can-do [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], full of vigor and enthusiasm, that would quickly move from one [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to the next, excited to battle the Confederacy's forces, as propaganda for the Republic's loyalists.<ref name="CN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 44th Division was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and the first novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="CN" />
